employers.name: Calder & Wren Retail
employers.about: An invented department-store group used only for QA. Stores in Singapore and Bengaluru.

roles.title: Head of Category, Grocery
roles.text:
About the role
Lead the grocery category for our Singapore stores. You own the category P&L, vendor terms and the private-label roadmap.
What we are looking for
• 12–18 years in category management or buying
• P&L ownership above SGD 50 million
• Experience leading teams of 20 or more
• Based in Singapore; no relocation support

ghost_meter.note: A straightforward live role. Used here mainly as a Radar location exclusion.

roles.title: Category Manager, Home
roles.text:
About the role
Run the home category for our Bengaluru stores: assortment, pricing and promotions for 2,000 products.
What we are looking for
• 4–7 years in category management
• Strong vendor negotiation
• Comfortable with pricing data and SQL
• Based in Bengaluru

ghost_meter.note: Contradictory evidence: the page claims 3 days; the employer's own system has carried the role for 140. The system's date must win.

roles.title: Senior Manager, Private Label
roles.text:
About the role
Build our private-label range in Bengaluru with three manufacturing partners. You will own quality, cost and launch plans.
What we are looking for
• 7–11 years in private label, sourcing or category management
• Experience launching at least ten products
• Based in Bengaluru

ghost_meter.note: Ambiguous evidence: a plausible, well-written page for a followed employer whose own system does not list it. Must not be Real.
